name: raiders-router
description: Curated Claude Code marketplace bundling the RaidersRouter agent toolkit: native plugins (video, engineering skills, Codex), skills collections (OmniRoute, code-review-graph, AI-engineering, Openship), and locally authored wrapper/reference/translated skills (superfile, Strix, jcode, system-prompt corpus, ai-berkshire value investing, Graph Loop).

plugins.name: raiders-toolkit
plugins.description: Locally authored wrapper, reference, and translated skills for tools that are NOT native Claude Code plugins: superfile (terminal file-manager control & organization), Strix (autonomous pentest agent), jcode (fast Rust coding harness), system-prompt corpus reference, an English translation of the ai-berkshire value-investing research framework, and the Graph Loop method for turning a pile of notes into a walkable knowledge graph.

plugins.name: agent-architecture
plugins.description: Build, debug and train agents as three separate systems: the LOOP (turns, retries, budgets, exits), the GRAPH (nodes, edges, state, checkpoints), and the HARNESS (tools, permissions, sandboxes, evals, traces). Ships loop-graph-harness for design, agent-failure-triage for routing a symptom to the layer that owns it, and training-agentic-environments for RL/eval environment and reward design.

plugins.name: watch
plugins.description: Give Claude the ability to actually watch a video: yt-dlp download, ffmpeg frame extraction, captions with Whisper fallback. Requires `yt-dlp` and `ffmpeg` on PATH.

plugins.name: mattpocock-skills
plugins.description: Matt Pocock's engineering-workflow skills: TDD, code-review, diagnosing-bugs, domain-modeling, research, plus /grill-me, /triage, /implement, /to-spec, /handoff and more.

plugins.name: codex
plugins.description: Invoke OpenAI Codex from inside Claude Code for code review and task delegation: /codex:review, /codex:adversarial-review, /codex:rescue, /codex:transfer, /codex:status. Requires the Codex CLI installed locally.

plugins.name: omniroute-skills
plugins.description: OmniRoute agent skills (~43): omni-auth, omni-providers, omni-models, omni-combos-routing, omni-mcp, omni-agents-a2a and CLI skills, adapted from the upstream skills/ tree. Pair with the OmniRoute MCP server for live tool access.

plugins.name: code-review-graph
plugins.description: Local-first code-intelligence graph for token-efficient AI reviews. Ships 7 skills (build-graph, explore-codebase, review-changes, review-delta, review-pr, refactor-safely, debug-issue). A ~30-tool MCP server is available separately via `code-review-graph serve`.

plugins.name: ai-engineering-skills
plugins.description: Two committed skills from the AI-Engineering-from-Scratch curriculum: find-your-level (placement quiz mapping your ML knowledge to a curriculum entry point) and check-understanding. The wider generated catalog installs via `npx skills add rohitg00/ai-engineering-from-scratch`.

plugins.name: openship-config
plugins.description: The openship-config skill bundled by the Openship self-hosted deployment platform, for configuring Openship deployments/routing from Claude Code.
